text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, during an extended period of intense training, Super Creek approaches me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Did you know Tamtam is growing vegetables? Want to take a little break and go have a look?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, you have so many different types of vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Pretty cool, yeah? The li'l runts saved their allowances and sent me the seeds.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah, my li'l siblings.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: They say I'll get real fast if I eat a buncha tasty veggies.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But it takes 'em forever to grow. Haha!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You look like you're enjoying yourself, Tamtam.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah, well, ya know. I'll let y'all eat some too when they get nice and big!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days after visiting Tamamo Cross's vegetable patch, Super Creek and I are discussing training, when…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Man… I used fertilizer and everythin'…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tamtam?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey. You guys want somethin'?
choice_data_list: You mentioned something about fertilizer just now…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Are your vegetables not doing well?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh… Heh. Yeah, well, it's no biggie.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'll figure somethin' out! No worries!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: …Um, Tamtam? Why don't we look into it together?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whatcha mean by that?
choice_data_list: Let's find a way to perk your veggies up!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ya seriously don't need ta worry 'bout it. I bet you're all busy and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And it's not like we got a pro veggie grower 'round here just readily available ta help us. It's not somethin' ya can easily look up either, so it'd be a waste of ti—
choice_data_list: I'm sure there's someone around with the know-how.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That's right. Oh, what about Flower? Why don't we go and ask her?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Flower? Ya mean Nishino Flower?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ya don't gotta come along. I can go and ask myself.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well, I think it'd be best if we all pepped these veggies up together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You, Trainer, and me! Let's go shower them with affection!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Everything shines more brightly when raised with lots of love.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: L-love? I dunno how ya say such embarrassin' things with a straight face…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …It's just a buncha veggies.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I know you don't see them that way.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Urk…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And it's not just the vegetables that I want to shower with love.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My adorable little Tamtam! I want to smother you with affection too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: H-hell no! Your affection's way too sweet!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, look at you getting all embarrassed. Adorable!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek smiles at the sight of Tamamo Cross's flushed cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I couldn't agree more.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …Listen. Yer gettin' too caught up in my business.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I don't want you postponin' your trainin' just to help me out.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Goodness… Did you hear that, Trainer? What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I agree!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? That don't make sense! The hell ya sayin'?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You may as well give in to the inevitable.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: While training is important, we can always make up the lost time.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But vegetables are living things. Let's all work together to save them, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nnh…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Their lives were a precious gift from someone special. Right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. You're right, Creek.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Sorry, and thanks for the help!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Glad to be of service! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek smiles in response to Tamamo Cross's words of gratitude.
